title: Fixing the leaking bucket: Financial factors and the improved performance of India's electricity distribution utilities
Managing Zero-Marginal-Cost, Intermittent Renewable Energy: A Survey of the Engineering, Economic, and Policy Challenges
Presidents, Prices at the Pump, and the Difference in Perceptions between Energy Market Experts and Non-experts
abstract: We conduct a survey of US-based energy market experts and non-experts and find that non-experts are significantly more likely to believe the US President plays a major role in determining retail fuel prices. Next, we analyze weekly retail gasoline and diesel price data from the US, UK, France, and Canada under different heads of state. After controlling for fluctuations in the wholesale crude oil price, country-specific long-run averages in prices, common time shocks, and national fuel excise taxes, we find that fuel prices differ significantly across leaders. Although we do not claim to have established a causal link between executive regime change and retail fuel price variation, our fuel price analysis does help explain why many people believe political executives can influence retail gasoline prices. We also make a call to economists to fill the notable gap in the economic and policy research on the influence of executive action on retail fuel prices and to look for other potential gaps by paying closer attention to similarly prominent economic narratives.
abstract_zh: 我们对美国能源市场专家和非专家进行了调查，发现非专家显著更可能相信美国总统在决定零售燃油价格方面发挥着重要作用。接着，我们分析了美国、英国、法国和加拿大在不同国家元首任期内的每周零售汽油和柴油价格数据。在控制了批发原油价格的波动、各国价格的长期平均水平、共同的时间冲击以及各国燃油消费税之后，我们发现燃油价格在不同领导人任期内存在显著差异。尽管我们并未确立行政机构更迭与零售燃油价格变动之间的因果关系，但我们的燃油价格分析确实有助于解释，为何许多人相信政治行政长官能够影响零售汽油价格。我们还呼吁经济学家填补经济学和政策研究中关于行政行动对零售燃油价格影响的明显空白，并通过更加关注类似的突出经济叙事，寻找其他潜在的研究空白。

title: Do hyperlocal regulations hinder green technology adoption?
Google Trends and Going Green: Public Engagement and Energy Policy under Centralized versus Decentralized Governance Systems
Population growth, age structure, and socio-economic performance
The Emissions Cost of the Solar Rebound for the United States
abstract: Rooftop solar delivers its promised emissions reductions only if each kilowatt-hour (kWh) generated displaces a kWh supplied by the grid. In practice it does not: households that adopt solar photovoltaic (PV) systems increase their electricity consumption after installation-the solar rebound effect (SRE)-by roughly 10-30% of their systems' generation, on average. We provide the first national accounting of the emissions cost of this behavioral response for the United States. Combining installation-level data on 4.5 million residential PV systems (1998-2024) with zip-code-level estimates of the marginal environmental damages from CO 2 and local air pollutants avoided by displacing grid-supplied electricity, we compute the social cost of the grid generation that rooftop solar fails to displace because of the SRE. At a 20% rebound, this forgone environmental benefit reached $1.4-2.4 billion annually in 2024 alone and at least $8.1 billion (constant 2024 USD) cumulatively since 2010, rising in lockstep with installed capacity. The costs are spatially concentrated where high adoption intersects carbon-intensive grids-not only the Southwest, but New Jersey and the Upper Midwest. Ignoring the SRE therefore systematically overstates the environmental benefits of residential rooftop solar. Compensation mechanisms, storage co-adoption, and the distributed versus utility-scale mix can materially shrink this gap.
abstract_zh: 屋顶太阳能只有在每千瓦时（kWh）的发电量都替代了电网供电的情况下，才能兑现其承诺的减排效果。但实际上并非如此：安装了太阳能光伏（PV）系统的家庭，在安装后会增加其电力消费——即太阳能反弹效应（SRE）——平均约为其系统发电量的10%至30%。我们首次对美国这一行为反应的减排成本进行了全国性核算。我们将450万套住宅光伏系统（1998–2024年）的装置层面数据，与邮政编码区层面的边际环境损害估计值相结合，后者衡量了通过替代电网供电所避免的CO2和地方空气污染物排放。基于这些数据，我们计算了由于SRE而未能被屋顶太阳能替代的电网发电所产生的社会成本。在20%的反弹率下，仅2024年一年，这一被放弃的环境效益就达到14亿至24亿美元，自2010年以来累计至少达81亿美元（按2024年不变美元计算），并随装机容量同步增长。成本在空间上高度集中于高采用率与高碳密集型电网相重叠的地区——不仅包括西南部，也包括新泽西州和中西部北部。因此，忽视SRE会系统性地高估住宅屋顶太阳能的环境效益。补偿机制、储能的同步采用，以及分布式与公用事业规模的组合，都可以显著缩小这一差距。

title: Is there a trade-off between forest expansion and agriculture? Evidence from India
abstract: Expanding forest areas through afforestation and reforestation is a popular strategy to mitigate climate change. However, the vast land area needed suggests a potentially large trade-off between forest expansion and agriculture. From 2003 to 2010, one of the largest forest expansion programs in India was implemented in Rajasthan state. We estimate the effects of this program on the agricultural sector using two-way fixed effects and synthetic difference-in-differences approaches, finding that it had no impact on the cultivated area in Rajasthan. Moreover, agricultural production and yield increased following the program’s implementation. We discuss implications for afforestation and reforestation as climate mitigation strategies.
abstract_zh: 通过造林和再造林扩大森林面积，是减缓气候变化的常用策略。然而，所需的巨大土地面积表明，森林扩张与农业之间可能存在巨大的权衡取舍。2003年至2010年间，印度拉贾斯坦邦实施了印度规模最大的森林扩张计划之一。我们采用双向固定效应和合成双重差分方法，估计了该计划对农业部门的影响，结果发现它并未对拉贾斯坦邦的耕地面积产生影响。此外，计划实施后，农业生产和单产均有所提高。我们讨论了造林和再造林作为气候减缓策略的含义。

title: Microeconomics of the Solar Rebound under Net Metering
venue: Journal of the Association of Environmental & Resource Economists
abstract: Residential solar photovoltaics generate “green” electricity but may also lead to an increase in household electricity consumption—a phenomenon termed the “solar rebound effect.” This study develops a theoretical framework for understanding the solar rebound. We show that the solar rebound is inherently linked to the net-metering compensation a household faces. While the solar rebound is often simply a pure income effect, it can also include a substitution effect in some policy contexts. A negative solar rebound is even possible. We derive the welfare effects of the solar rebound and provide insights for econometric estimation.
abstract_zh: 住宅太阳能光伏发电产生“绿色”电力，但也可能导致家庭用电量增加——这一现象被称为“太阳能反弹效应”。本研究构建了一个理论框架，用以理解太阳能反弹效应。我们表明，太阳能反弹效应与家庭所面临的净计量补偿内在相关。太阳能反弹效应往往仅仅是纯粹的收入效应，但在某些政策背景下，它也可能包含替代效应。甚至可能出现负的太阳能反弹效应。我们推导了太阳能反弹效应的福利效应，并为计量经济估计提供了相应见解。

title: The Economics of Integrating Distributed Energy Resources into the Electricity System
venue: Distributed Generation - Pioneering the Future of Decentralized Energy (IntechOpen)
abstract: This chapter provides a broad overview of current economic issues related to integrating distributed energy resources (DERs)—primarily solar photovoltaics (PV) and battery electric storage (BES)—into the electricity system, and the implications this has for electricity markets. Topics covered include (but are not limited to) generation intermittency, merit-order effects, the ‘duck curve’ problem, resource adequacy and the ‘missing-money’ problem, efficient investment in flexible generation and storage, implications for the electricity transmission and retail distribution systems, incentivizing adoption of DERs, and the solar rebound effect. The chapter’s general aim is to provide a non-economics audience with a broad sense of the current state of economic research on these topics.
abstract_zh: 本章概述了与将分布式能源资源（DERs）——主要是太阳能光伏（PV）和电池储能（BES）——整合进电力系统相关的当前经济问题，以及这些问题对电力市场的影响。涵盖的主题包括（但不限于）发电间歇性、边际成本次序效应（merit-order effects）、“鸭子曲线”（duck curve）问题、资源充足性与“缺失货币”（missing-money）问题、灵活性发电和储能的有效投资、对输电和配电系统的影响、激励DER采用的政策，以及太阳能反弹效应。本章的总体目标是让非经济学背景的读者大致了解这些主题的当前经济学研究状况。

title: Wind intermittency and supply-demand imbalance: Evidence from U.S. regional power markets
Electricity Consumption Changes Following Solar Adoption: Testing for a Solar Rebound
abstract: We use household‐level data to explore residential electricity use patterns following installation of solar panels. Solar adoption leads to an increase in total electricity consumption relative to a matched non‐adopting control group. Our point estimate translates to a rebound effect of 28.5%, suggesting that nearly a third of the electricity produced by a customer's solar panels is used for increased energy services, rather than reduced grid electricity consumption. We explore several potential drivers of an increase in electricity consumption. These results have important implications for electricity planning and policy, suggesting that rooftop solar stimulates additional demand for electricity.
abstract_zh: 我们利用家庭层面的数据，考察安装太阳能板后居民用电模式的变化。相对于匹配的未采用太阳能的对照组，采用太阳能会使总用电量增加。我们的点估计对应的反弹效应为28.5%，这表明客户太阳能板发出的电力中，近三分之一被用于增加的能源服务，而非减少电网用电。我们探讨了用电量增加的若干潜在驱动因素。这些结果对电力规划和政策具有重要意义，表明屋顶太阳能会刺激额外的电力需求。

title: Tipping the scale: Why utility-scale solar avoids a solar rebound and what it means for U.S. solar policy
Are energy endowed countries responsible for conditional convergence?
abstract: We test for economic convergence in GDP per capita and consumption per capita within two distinct sets of countries: those with significant (and plausibly exogenous) fossil fuel (FF) endowments and those without such endowments. Among countries with FF endowments, we find evidence of both absolute and conditional convergence across both macroeconomic dimensions, as indicated by standard P- and o-convergence tests. By contrast, we do not find robust evidence of convergence among countries without FF endowments. This pattern—convergence among FF-endowed and non-convergence among non-endowed countries—is robust to changes in the sample period, controlling for potential resource curse effects, and is largely consistent across growth components. We discuss the implications for economic development and comment on its implications for global decarbonization policies.
abstract_zh: 我们检验了两组国家内部人均GDP和人均消费的经济收敛情况：一组是拥有显著的（且可合理视为外生的）化石燃料（FF）禀赋的国家，另一组是没有此类禀赋的国家。在拥有化石燃料禀赋的国家中，我们在两个宏观经济维度上都发现了绝对收敛和条件收敛的证据，标准的P收敛和σ收敛检验均表明了这一点。相比之下，在没有化石燃料禀赋的国家中，我们并未发现稳健的收敛证据。这种“拥有化石燃料禀赋的国家趋于收敛、无禀赋国家不收敛”的格局，在改变样本期、控制潜在的资源诅咒效应后依然稳健，并且在各增长成分中基本一致。我们讨论了其对经济发展的含义，并评论了其对全球脱碳政策的启示。

title: Trading One Waste for Another? Unintended Consequences of Fly Ash Reuse in the Indian Electric Power Sector
Setting carbon taxes using declining discount rates: Implications for investment-based mitigation
abstract: The use of declining discount rates (DDR) to calculate the net present value of damages associated with climate change has important ramifications for climate policy. We examine the behavior of a firm subject to climate-based market interventions, specifically carbon taxes or abatement credits that are indexed to the social cost of carbon (SCC). Recognizing that private abatement investment decisions are financed via capital markets, we show that when the SCC is calculated using a DDR it is impossible for the policymaker to induce a level of investment today that is consistent with the SCC forecast for future periods. This leads to significant under-investment in abatement. We discuss the practical implications of this result for climate policy, with particular focus on climate policies designed to foster investment-based mitigation.
abstract_zh: 使用递减贴现率（DDR）计算气候变化损害的净现值，对气候政策具有重要影响。我们考察了一家受基于气候的市场干预约束的企业的行为，具体包括与社会碳成本（SCC）挂钩的碳税或减排信用。考虑到私人减排投资决策是通过资本市场融资的，我们表明，当SCC采用DDR计算时，政策制定者不可能诱导出与未来各期SCC预测相一致的当期投资水平。这将导致减排投资严重不足。我们讨论了这一结果对气候政策的实际含义，并特别关注旨在促进投资型减缓的气候政策。

title: Framework for estimation of the direct rebound effect for residential photovoltaic systems
Pricing flexibility under rate-of-return regulation: Effects on network infrastructure investment
Renewable generation capacity and wholesale electricity price variance
abstract: The share of electric power generated from renewable energy sources such as wind and solar must increase dramatically in the coming decades if greenhouse gas emissions are to be reduced to sustainable levels. An under-researched implication of such a transition in competitive wholesale electricity markets is that greater wind and solar generation capacity directly affects wholesale price variability. In theory, two counter-vailing forces should be at work. First, greater wind and solar generation capacity should reduce short-run variance in the wholesale electricity price due to a stochastic merit-order effect. However, increasing the generation capacity of these technologies may increase price variance due to an intermittency effect. Using an instrumental variables identification strategy to control for endogeneity, we find evidence that greater combined wind and solar generation capacity is associated with an increase in the quarterly variance of wholesale electricity prices. That is, the intermittency effect dominates the stochastic merit-order effect.
abstract_zh: 如果要将温室气体排放降低到可持续水平，风能和太阳能等可再生能源发电在电力总量中的份额必须在未来几十年大幅提高。在竞争性批发电力市场中，这一转型一个研究不足的含义是，风能和太阳能发电容量的增加会直接影响批发电价的波动性。理论上，有两种相互抵消的力量在起作用。首先，风能和太阳能发电容量的增加，由于随机的边际成本次序效应，应当降低批发电价的短期方差。然而，这些技术的发电容量增加，也可能因间歇性效应而提高价格方差。我们采用工具变量识别策略以控制内生性，发现风能和太阳能合计发电容量的增加与批发电价季度方差的上升相关。也就是说，间歇性效应占主导地位，超过了随机的边际成本次序效应。

title: Microeconomics of the rebound effect for residential solar photovoltaic systems
Natural gas pipeline regulation in the United States: Past, present, and future
abstract: This monograph provides a detailed overview of federal-level regulation of the U.S. interstate natural gas pipeline industry. To develop a more complete understanding of the current regulatory environment, we place contemporary rules and regulations into their proper historical context by first reviewing the evolution of gas pipeline regulation over the course of the 20th Century. We then discuss the market restructuring process that culminated in 1992 with FERC Order No. 636, review the economic and policy research that studied its effects on pipeline operations (and on the U.S. natural gas market writ large), and examine the current regulations and industry structure that have since emerged. Finally, we explore possibilities for the future of regulation in the gas pipeline industry, offering some predictions regarding the likely direction of regulatory changes, paying particular attention to the possibility of incentive-based regulation in natural gas transmission.
abstract_zh: 本专著详细概述了美国州际天然气管道行业的联邦层面监管。为全面理解当前的监管环境，我们将当代规章制度置于其适当的历史背景中，首先回顾20世纪天然气管道监管的演变。随后，我们讨论了以1992年联邦能源监管委员会第636号令（FERC Order No. 636）为标志的市场重组过程，回顾了研究其对管道运营（以及对整个美国天然气市场）影响的经济和政策研究，并考察了此后形成的当前监管规则和行业结构。最后，我们探讨了天然气管道行业监管的未来可能性，对监管变革的可能方向作出预测，并特别关注天然气输送中基于激励的监管的可能性。

title: Reassessing the links between economic growth, GHG emissions, and the UNFCCC: A difference-in-differences approach
abstract: International climate agreements such as the Kyoto Protocol of 1997 and, more recently, the Paris Climate Agreement are fragile because, at a national level, political constituencies’ value systems may conflict with the goal of reducing greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions to sustainable levels. Proponents cite climate change as the most pressing challenge of our time, contending that international cooperation will play an essential role in addressing this challenge. Political opponents argue that the disproportionate requirements on developed nations to shoulder the financial burden will inhibit their economic growth. We find empirical evidence that both arguments are likely to be correct. We use standard regression techniques to analyze a multi-country dataset of GHG emissions, GDP per capita growth, and other factors. We estimate that after the Kyoto Protocol (KP) entered into force ‘Annex I’ countries reduced GHG emissions on average by roughly 1 million metric tons of CO2 equivalent (MTCO2e), relative to non-Annex I countries. However, our estimates reveal that these countries also experienced an average reduction in GDP per capita growth rates of around 1–2 percentage points relative to non-Annex I countries.
abstract_zh: 诸如1997年《京都议定书》以及近期的《巴黎协定》等国际气候协议十分脆弱，因为在国家层面上，政治选民的价值体系可能与将温室气体（GHG）排放减至可持续水平的目标相冲突。支持者认为气候变化是我们这个时代最紧迫的挑战，并主张国际合作将在应对这一挑战中发挥关键作用。政治反对者则认为，发达国家承担的过度要求将抑制其经济增长。我们发现有实证证据表明，这两种观点都可能是正确的。我们利用标准回归方法，分析了一个多国数据集，其中包括温室气体排放、人均GDP增长率以及其他因素。我们估计，《京都议定书》生效后，附件一（Annex I）国家的温室气体排放相对于非附件一国家平均减少了约100万公吨二氧化碳当量（MTCO2e）。然而，我们的估计还表明，这些国家的人均GDP增长率相对于非附件一国家也平均下降了约1至2个百分点。

title: An overview of interstate gas pipeline regulation in the United States
Taming drillers through legislative action: Evidence from Pennsylvania's shale gas industry
Contests, common agency, and corruption: Why the green candidate seldom wins
abstract: Public sector corruption has been linked to resource dependency and environmental degradation in the developing world. Herein, we examine the persistence of public sector corruption by modeling an elected public official with the power to set agricultural/resource input-subsidization policy in a developing economy. Through common agency, firms offer bribes to influence policy. A more corrupt official extracts a greater bribe. This implies in a political contest between two candidates with different propensities for corruption, the corrupt incumbent, having the greater prize at stake, always expends greater effort and is the contest favorite. The less corrupt 'green' challenger is always the contest underdog. Our results suggest that i) corruption is politically advantageous; and ii) corruption and political instability are mutually reinforcing, leading to over-harvesting and too much pollution.
abstract_zh: 公共部门腐败与发展中经济体的资源依赖和环境退化相联系。在此，我们通过构建一个模型考察公共部门腐败的持续性，模型中一名民选公职人员有权制定发展中经济体农业/资源投入补贴政策。在共同代理（common agency）框架下，企业通过行贿来影响政策。腐败程度越高的官员，所获贿赂越多。这意味着，在两名腐败倾向不同的候选人之间的政治竞争中，腐败的现任者由于其面临的奖励更大，总是付出更多的努力，并且总是竞选中的热门者。腐败程度较低的“绿色”挑战者总是处于竞选中的劣势。我们的结果表明：一是腐败在政治上具有优势；二是腐败与政治不稳定相互强化，导致过度采伐和过度污染。

title: Economies of scale and scope in expansion of the U.S. natural gas pipeline network
Climate policy coordination through institutional design: An experimental examination
General equilibrium ecosystem modeling with alternative preference specifications
abstract: This paper reconciles two sets of literature with regard to the interactive ecological and economic impacts of invasive grass species and cattle stocking. We model cattle as optimal foragers, satiation foragers, and proportional foragers in order to understand the impact that each assumption imposes on predicted economic and ecological outcomes. Through this model sensitivity (as opposed to parameter sensitivity) analysis, we are able to identify three main drivers of plant invasions: exogenous forces such as climate change or nitrogen deposition, poor land management decisions, and a misalignment of incentives between cattle and ranchers even when ranchers behave optimally.
abstract_zh: 本文调和了两组文献，它们分别涉及入侵草种与放牧牛群之间相互作用的生态和经济影响。我们将牛群建模为最优觅食者、饱足觅食者和比例觅食者，以理解每一假设对预测的经济和生态结果所施加的影响。通过这种模型敏感性（而非参数敏感性）分析，我们识别出植物入侵的三个主要驱动因素：气候变化或氮沉降等外生力量、不当的土地管理决策，以及即便牧场主行为最优，牛群与牧场主之间激励的错位。

title: Linking zebra mussel invasion and interstate waterborne commerce in the U.S.A.
Pipeline congestion and basis differentials
